title: Sidechain routing for compressors keyed from a track or group
description:
## Intent

Sidechained compressors.

## Steps

- In the Compressor mapping, `CompSpec.sidechain` (a track or group name) → the device's sidechain on and routed from that track's output per the routing format in `design/daw-set.md`; a track spread over several audio tracks is keyed from its group.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Sidechain" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): sidechain routing in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
